title: Vulnetix config: shared definitions
description: Definitions every Vulnetix config kind refers to. Not a document kind itself.

apiVersion.description: The document format version. Every kind in this release is vulnetix.com/v1.

name.description: The object's name, unique per kind within a tenant. It is the natural key: plan, apply, export and the Terraform provider all address an object by kind and name.

org.description: The tenant (organization UUID) the document belongs to. When set, plan and apply refuse to run against any other tenant.

labels.description: Free key/value labels. Stored with the object, never interpreted by the server.

annotations.description: Free key/value notes for people and tools, such as a ticket link.

singletonMetadata.description: Metadata for a kind the tenant has exactly one of. The name is fixed to default.

valueFrom.description: Where a client reads a secret value. The value is resolved on the machine running the client, sent once, and never exported or shown in a plan.

file.description: Path to a file holding the value. Trailing newlines are trimmed.

celExpression.description: A CEL expression (https://cel.dev) returning bool. The variables it may use depend on where it appears; each kind's reference lists them. Plan type-checks the expression.

purl.description: A package URL (https://github.com/package-url/purl-spec). Omit the version to mean every version.

vexJustification.description: Why a vulnerability does not affect a product, in the OpenVEX 0.2.0 vocabulary. CycloneDX VEX justifications map onto these.
